name: manual_151639
claim: Before filing uncommitted changes into salvage buckets, classify dirty state by repo and risk; submodule drift that points at commits not present locally should be deferred rather than bundled into unrelated PRs.

decisions.notes: 2026-07-14 Perpetua-Tools only had vendor/ecc-tools drift showing commits not present, so it was excluded from both G7 and housecleaning buckets and left for a dedicated reconciliation pass.
